detail.longDescription: Hello, Mathstodon! 👋 AI is changing how maths is done, refereed and taught. We think research mathematicians should help decide how. Futures of Maths is an anonymous consultation where you vote on short statements about AI in maths, add your own, and see where the community agrees and where it splits. 400+ mathematicians have joined so far. Takes ~5 min to start: 🔗 https:// community.futuresofmaths.com Boosts very welcome 🙏 # Mathematics # AI # Math # Maths # Research
